# Research

## Research Interests

I am interested in the intersection of **medicine, biology and computation**, particularly in areas where computational methods can help answer biomedical and clinical questions.

### 🧬 Genomics & Bioinformatics

Exploring genomic and biological sequence data to understand variation, conservation and biological function.

### 💻 Computational Biology

Using programming, data analysis and computational methods to investigate biological systems.

### 🧪 Biomedical Research

Interested in research connecting molecular biology, disease mechanisms and clinical medicine.

### 🌍 Public Health

Interested in how computational approaches can contribute to population-level health research.

---

## Current Direction

My current learning is focused on building a strong foundation in **Python, Linux, Bash, Git, bioinformatics and data analysis**.

Through practical projects, I am working toward developing the ability to independently take a biological question, obtain and analyse relevant data, and communicate the results clearly.
